items.title: Is HealthStream (HSTM) a Better Healthcare Bet Than Humana (HUM) Right Now?
items.summary: On August 11, Humana Inc. (NYSE:HUM) announced that its Medicaid plan, Humana Healthy Horizons in Indiana, is collaborating with HealthStream, Inc. (NASDAQ:HSTM). The partnership expands access to workforce training for caregivers, aiming to recruit and retain talent in rural and underserved communities. items.title: Why Is UNH Stock Trading At A Premium With The Slowest Growth?
items.summary: UnitedHealth (UNH) runs the best operating margin of the three managed care companies in its peer group, and the slowest revenue growth of the three. It also carries a significant valuation premium over its peer, Cigna, trading at more than double its earnings multiple.

items.title: Can UnitedHealth's AI Strategy Strengthen Optum Insight's Growth?
items.summary: UNH is investing nearly $1.5B in AI to expand Optum Insight's software offerings, boost efficiency and unlock new growth opportunities.

items.title: Is Humana Stock Outperforming the Dow?
items.summary: Humana has outperformed the broader Dow Jones index over the past year. Moreover, Wall Street analysts remain moderately optimistic about its prospects.

items.title: UnitedHealth Slips 3% as TPG Buys Into Florida WellMed Clinics Ahead of Guidance Reaffirmation
items.summary: TPG just bought into the exact Optum clinics that derailed UnitedHealth's profits, and management is hours away from reaffirming guidance that could either validate the deal or reopen a wound investors hoped was healing.

items.title: Insurers Have Already Told Wall Street Which Advantage Plans Die on December 31. Members Are the Last to Know, and the Letter Isn’t Due Until October 2.
items.summary: Insurers spent the summer telling Wall Street exactly which Medicare Advantage plans are disappearing on December 31. Enrolled members get a letter in October, a closing enrollment window in December, and a rare legal protection most will never realize they have.

items.title: UnitedHealth Stock Rises 39% in 6 Months: Should Investors Still Buy?
items.summary: UNH's 39% six-month rally reflects improving medical costs, stronger earnings estimates and a sharper focus on profitable businesses.

items.title: 1 High-Flying Stock for Long-Term Investors and 2 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: “You get what you pay for” often applies to expensive stocks with best-in-class business models and execution. While their quality can sometimes justify the premium, they typically experience elevated volatility during market downturns when expectations change.
